A '''Plank Gas canister''' was an ammunition type for use with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]]. It was loaded with [[plank gas]], a corrosive element that could incapacitate targets.
